build_colbert_reranker: build a ColbertRerankerBiEncoder model with question and context encoders for dense passage reranking
create_cross_encoder: create a BERTRerankerCrossEncoder model that combines question and context into a single cross-attention input
run_colbert_forward: run ColbertRerankerBiEncoder forward pass to compute question-context interaction scores via max-pooling
prepare_cross_encoder_inputs: prepare model inputs for BERTRerankerCrossEncoder by concatenating question and context tokens with proper segment IDs
get_reranker_loss: get RerankerNLL loss function for training ColbertRerankerBiEncoder or BERTRerankerCrossEncoder models
